world.docs: World pack contract v1; see viewer/docs/object-scaling-proposal.md, "Appendix: world pack format". Placements are Float32 x10 TRS (px,py,pz,qx,qy,qz,qw,sx,sy,sz) in site-local metres: site-local = map-centred world metres - (mean(map.towers[].pos) - 0.5) * worldM, and Y = (cell.centreElevM - site.centreElevM) + py. Library geometry carries position/normal plus normalized 8-bit vertex colours baked from the cell scene materials[name].color; one shared MeshStandardMaterial (roughness 0.92, metalness 0.04, vertexColors) reproduces the site packs' per-material baseColorFactor exactly. Mirrored (negative determinant) placements reference the reflected geometry "<model>:m". Vegetation exists at LQ only, and models whose largest bounding-box dimension is under 2 m are absent from the MQ library; the runtime skips a placement whose active tier lacks its model.
